prompt: Create a high-fidelity static desktop website mockup of ONLY the enquiry form section of Dapper Detailing Pros Contact Us page, landscape 1536x1024. This is a section below the already approved opening, not another hero or entire page. Attached reference is the approved opening: inherit its off-white background, bold geometric sans typography, restrained red accents, crisp rectangular controls and editorial spacing. Do NOT repeat its navigation, car photograph, giant opening headline or contact-information strip. No decorative eyebrow or numbered sections. The visitor's task is to ask a question about their vehicle. Include a complete readable empty form, visible persistent labels, name required, email required, phone optional, vehicle optional, service dropdown with default “Choose a service”, message required, a short “Required fields are marked *” note, and a red “Send enquiry” button. Vehicle hint “Year, make and model”. Message hint “Tell us what you have in mind.” A small privacy link and “Submitting an enquiry does not book an appointment.” below form. No invented response-time promise, no prefilled personal data, no marketing opt-in or policy checkbox. No extra page sections, maps, photographs or footer. Crisp readable realistic website UI, no device frame. Preserve substantial input heights and sufficient whitespace to actually complete the form. OPTION C: a letter-inspired form, not a standard left-copy right-form split. A compact black headline “A note to Dapper.” with red final period sits on the left along the top, and supporting sentence “Tell us what you have in mind.” sits opposite. Below is a single broad white stationery-like sheet on the off-white canvas, with generous margins, a restrained thin charcoal top rule and absolutely no drop shadow, faux handwriting or paper textures. Inside sheet, small bold salutation “Hello, Dapper.” anchors the upper left. Full-width labelled Message textarea comes FIRST and is clearly a form input, approximately 200px high, with subdued outline. Below, horizontal paired labelled inputs Name* and Email*, then Phone (optional) and Vehicle (optional), then Service (optional) dropdown “Choose a service”. Use persistent labels and understated but visible rectangular input boundaries, making this an accessible ordinary form dressed as an editorial letter, not sentences with hidden inline blanks. At the bottom right red “Send enquiry” control; left small exact text “Required fields are marked *” and “Privacy Policy” and “Submitting an enquiry does not book an appointment.” Do NOT add any text saying the visitor agrees to a policy. Make the entire section visible without cropping fields or button. Visual focal point is the open message area, generous horizontal rhythm and letter salutation. Keep the approved Dapper editorial world and clean typography throughout.
implementationNote: Service remains optional; remove generated required service marker in B.
